title: Mission release countdown
description: Official missions are not released yet. Use this time to learn how to quickly sort missions once the field is revealed.

title: Push / pull missions
description: Look for missions where the robot moves an object by pushing, pulling, sliding, or dragging.

title: Drop-off missions
description: Look for missions where the robot carries an object and leaves it in a target area.

title: Pickup missions
description: Look for missions where the robot needs to grab, trap, or collect an object and bring it back.

title: Lift missions
description: Look for missions that need an arm, lever, or vertical movement.
